title: [CmdPal] Two-character queries no longer find apps by substring (regression since #49249)

judgment.rationale: The live source supports investigating the short-query gate independently of the reporter's PR attribution. Preserve relevance/noise protections and use exact suffix fixtures before choosing between boundary classification and contiguous-substring policy.
evidence: PROD04, TEST04, DEV04 and DEMO04 fail to appear for 04 while prefixes and D04 work.

proposed_fixes.title: Refine short-query eligibility for contiguous suffixes
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Contiguous numeric suffixes can fall below the filter's boundary/acronym tier and be withheld despite useful exact substring intent.
plan: Capture match tiers and filter decisions for the supplied four-shortcut fixture.
Choose a bounded contiguous-substring or letter/digit-boundary rule only after comparing noise and ranking controls.
Add exact suffix, scattered-fuzzy, prefix and one-character regression cases.
verification: 04 finds all four intended shortcuts under the approved policy.
Weak scattered one/two-character matches remain controlled.
